findings.issue: Routes encode data-path strings that must stay in sync with the switch in loaders.ts (loadPageData), including a naming mismatch: route 'types/:name' builds path '/type/<name>'
findings.suggestion: Have each route own a reference to its loader function (e.g. put the loader in route.resolve via a registry keyed by component, or export loadX from a per-page module) so adding/renaming a page touches one place, and align path kinds with URL segments

findings.issue: Title generation depends on the hidden convention that every route's resolver output is keyed 'vm' and VMs expose 'title'; a new page that misses either silently degrades
findings.suggestion: Type the resolved data via a shared ResolvedPage type (or set title in route data at resolve time) so the contract is checked by the compiler

findings.issue: The media URL scheme ('/media/sprites/pokemon/<id>.png') is hardcoded in a client view component rather than delivered by the view model, unlike the artwork which comes from API data
findings.suggestion: Carry the sprite URL (or the whole Card's media ref) in the VM from loaders.ts so API-shape knowledge stays in the server data layer

findings.issue: The API base URL default 'http://localhost:9000' is duplicated in api-client.ts and page-data.ts:42
findings.suggestion: Define the default once (e.g. in a tiny shared constant) and reference it from both

findings.issue: Home duplicates the card-grid markup and card-data shape (id/name/types passed individually) already encapsulated by CardList/PokemonCard, so grid-level changes land twice
findings.suggestion: Add an optional count/header input to CardList (or a slot for filters/pagination) so home renders through the same component

findings.issue: Home re-maps type API names to labels client-side, duplicating the server's typeRef/typeLabels logic in loaders.ts:133-140
findings.suggestion: Put NamedRef[] (label included) into HomeEntry.types in the VM and delete the client-side mapping

findings.issue: Scroll-restoration policy lives in a hand-rolled constructor subscription with URL-diffing and afterNextRender, a dense block future maintainers must reason about
findings.suggestion: Extract the pathname/page-change detection into a named helper or move to router configuration with comments; keep behaviour, lose the inline statefulness

findings.issue: Inconsistent service style: PageTitleStrategy uses @Injectable() while PageData uses the now-preferred @Service() decorator (page-data.ts:41)
findings.suggestion: Standardize on @Service() for tree-shakeable root services

findings.issue: @angular/forms is declared as a dependency but never imported anywhere in src/

summary: A deliberately two-layer app: server loaders build typed view models, components render them, and the only contracts between the layers are the documented interfaces in shared/models.ts. Every scenario I walked lands in one or two well-named files, helped by shared primitives (PokemonCard, CardList, format helpers, loader helpers). The deductions are registries that must be edited in parallel (routes vs loader switch, resolver-key convention) and a couple of near-duplications (home's own card grid, hardcoded sprite scheme, duplicated base-URL default).
